headword: {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}

definitions.explanation: Time off from work during which the employee does not receive salary or wages. Taken for personal reasons, extended absences, or when paid leave has been exhausted.

examples.japanese: {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}を{取|と}って{海外|かいがい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I took unpaid leave and went overseas.

examples.japanese: {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}を{使|つか}い{切|き}ったので、{無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}を{申請|しんせい}した。
examples.english: Since I used up all my paid leave, I applied for unpaid leave.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{規定|きてい}では、{無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}は{最大|さいだい}で{三|さん}か{月|げつ}まで{認|みと}められている。
examples.english: Under company regulations, unpaid leave is allowed for up to three months.

notes:
A compound of {無給|むきゅう} (without pay) + {休暇|きゅうか} (leave, vacation). The opposite is {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか} (paid leave), commonly abbreviated to {有休|ゆうきゅう} or {有給|ゆうきゅう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}を{取|と}る: to take unpaid leave
- {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}を{申請|しんせい}する: to apply for unpaid leave
- {無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}が{認|みと}められる: unpaid leave is approved
- {長期|ちょうき}{無給休暇|むきゅうきゅうか}: extended unpaid leave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}: paid leave (leave during which salary continues)
- {休職|きゅうしょく}: leave of absence (formal suspension from duties, often for health reasons)
- {欠勤|けっきん}: absence from work (unscheduled, often implies not approved in advance)
